newsitem.title: ITALY: Alitalia, Nestle seal deal with a kiss.
newsitem.headline: Alitalia, Nestle seal deal with a kiss.

text.p: Italian flag carrier Alitalia and Swiss food and confectionery group Nestle sealed a promotional deal on Monday with a kiss -- literally.
As a marketing promotion for the Italian "Baci" (kisses) chocolates made by Nestle unit Perugina, Alitalia decked out its jumbo jet in the blue and silver colours of the baci wrapping.
Nestle funded the revamp, which cost some 500 million lire ($300,000), to kick off the deal to boost the image of its chocolates, which will last for an initial one year period.
The sponsorship is the first such deal since the troubled Italian flag carrier's re-launch last year.
The new-look Boeing 747, which sports the logo "Kisses from Italy, kisses from Alitalia" will makes its first trip from Rome to New York on Tuesday.
